note: The stable field conjecture emerged organically from early 1980s model-theoretic research but has no single definitive publication that explicitly posed it. Key background: Macintyre proved ω-stable fields are algebraically closed (1971); Ershov and Wood established that separably closed fields are stable (1967, 1979); Cherlin-Shelah proved superstable fields are algebraically closed (1980, but this paper does not explicitly pose the stable field conjecture). The natural question—are all stable fields separably closed?—appears to have developed implicitly from this progression. The conjecture is usually attributed to Shelah but no direct quote of him formally stating it in a published work has been located. The research direction solidified by early 1980s but the explicit conjecture statement date is unresolved.
